title: Implement tenant-bound authoritative Persona training targets
summary_zh: training-authority-contract-audit.json 與 report.md 3.1 節指出：services/training-session/persona_target.py 的凍結 validator 要求 Persona owner 提供 tenant_id/generation/authority_status/controller_record_ref/recorded_at 的 precondition readback、接受 generation/precondition-digest/approved-teaching-proof 綁定的 target writer，以及該 generation 的 terminal target readback，但既有 services/persona/write_owner.py 只有一般 create/patch/lifecycle/capability-snapshot 端點，完全沒有這三個介面。此任務只在 services/persona/write_owner.py 新增一個獨立、持久化、tenant 綁定的 training-target 資源（GET+POST /api/personas/{persona_id}/training-target），滿足凍結 validator 的每一個必填欄位與 CAS/idempotency 語意，不修改 persona_target.py 本身、不碰 Governance owner（DOMAIN-WRITERS-001 範圍），也不改動既有 PersonaBody 的一般欄位語意。

owned: New PersistentPersonaTrainingTargetOwner: a durable, tenant-bound, generation-versioned record per persona_id, backed by the same AtomicJsonRecordStore/PostgresJsonOwnerStore pattern already used by PersistentPersonaOwner and PersistentCapabilitySnapshotOwner

GET /api/personas/{persona_id}/training-target (X-Tenant-Id header): serves as the frozen contract's persona precondition readback both for a standalone pre-evaluation read and for commit_persona_target's internal pre-readback, and as the terminal readback after a commit -- one durable resource read at every stage, no in-process cache or fixture fallback

POST /api/personas/{persona_id}/training-target (X-Tenant-Id, Idempotency-Key headers): commits one approved teaching target via compare-and-set on generation; enforces tenant isolation (403 TRAINING_TARGET_TENANT_MISMATCH via first-writer-wins tenant binding), stale-generation rejection (409), and idempotent-replay-vs-conflict semantics at the already-committed generation (identical binding replays 200 with replayed=true, differing binding is a 409 semantic idempotency conflict)

Reuses the existing service-token / JWT persona.admin authentication path (_authenticate_persona_mutation, _require_persona_plane_owner) for both new endpoints; requires the persona_id to already exist in the real PersistentPersonaOwner store before any training-target read or write is served
not_changing: services/training-session/persona_target.py -- the frozen client validator (PR #5593 head 48e32ff7427294be633b05bff66a110f91592c96) is exercised as-is via its public read_persona_target_precondition/commit_persona_target functions, loaded standalone exactly as its own test suite does; not one line of it is edited

The Governance owner service and its approval-decision contract (DOMAIN-WRITERS-001 scope) -- the approval readback the frozen validator performs is out of this task and is served from a fixed in-memory fake in the new focused tests

The existing generic Persona lifecycle/CRUD fields (PersonaBody.status/lifecycle_state and friends) -- the new training-target authority projection is a separate resource so the admin status vocabulary ({active, suspended, archived}) is never overloaded with the validator's distinct {active, committed} vocabulary
execute-plans FE PR #738 (head dbdb2f4ac621075e47f67f9b567b94f0cb06e6e2) -- untouched, no frontend files in this diff
No live credentials, no dev/prod deployment or mutation -- everything below runs against a temporary AtomicJsonRecordStore under pytest's tmp_path
known_gap: Deployment wiring (TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_READBACK_URL_TEMPLATE / _TARGET_WRITE_URL_TEMPLATE / _TARGET_READBACK_URL_TEMPLATE all pointing at this new resource path on the live persona-svc host, plus a real Governance approval readback) and hosted/dev acceptance are explicitly out of scope per the task brief -- root GPT-6 Astra owns integration validation and dev deployment. This delivery only proves the Persona-owner contract itself, end to end, against the exact frozen validator.

acceptance_mapping.tenant_isolation_generation_cas_idempote: PersistentPersonaTrainingTargetOwner.commit(): first-writer-wins tenant binding + compare_and_set on generation + binding-equality check at the already-committed generation
acceptance_mapping.cross_tenant_denial: test_cross_tenant_read_and_write_are_denied (GET and POST both return 403 for a second tenant against an already-tenant-bound persona)
acceptance_mapping.stale_generation: test_stale_generation_commit_is_rejected (a commit attempt whose expected_previous_generation no longer matches the current stored generation after two real commits returns 409)
acceptance_mapping.mismatched_or_expired_approval: already covered by the untouched frozen suite services/training-session/tests/test_persona_target.py (test_future_or_expired_approval_fails_closed, test_approval_identity_must_match_expected_proof_policy_authority) -- this task does not weaken or duplicate that boundary
acceptance_mapping.actual_policy_control_change_and_restart: test_precondition_read_commit_and_restart_readback re-instantiates PersistentPersonaOwner/PersistentPersonaTrainingTargetOwner from the same on-disk JSON path in a fresh FastAPI app + TestClient and confirms the exact committed generation/digests/controller_record_ref read back identically
acceptance_mapping.no_fabricated_controller_receipts_or_saf: controller_record_ref values are generated server-side per commit (uuid4-based, generation-scoped) only inside the real compare-and-set write path; no test or implementation code short-circuits the validator's authority_status/controller_record_ref/recorded_at/digest checks
